# 1. Generating a population of voters

```{r}
df = create_population_data(
    n_precincts = 2600,
    seed = 1234
)

head(df)

```


# 2. Add baseline votes

```{r}

df = add_baseline_votes(
    df
)

head(df)

```


# 3. Create Shapefile

```{r}

grid = create_realistic_grid(
    n_precincts = nrow(df), 
    n_centers = 5, 
    bounds = c(0, 1000, 0, 1000), 
    decay_rate = 15,
    base_density = 0.10,
    peak_multiplier = 10.00,
    decay_power = 1.00,
    center_radius = 10.00,
    seed = 1234
    )

```
